_note: Prebuilt assets of the paper (Google Drive). scripts/fetch_assets.py downloads them by file id, checks the SHA-256 and unpacks them into the repository root.

archives.name: crve_gate1_assets.tar.gz
archives.description: Vocabulary pools and the sparse lexical profiles with their Terrier indexes, 25 collections. Needed to reproduce CRVE exactly (a profile rebuild depends on the string hash seed).

archives.name: crve_s2_sidecars.tar.gz
archives.description: S2 context sidecars (chunks, term references, BGE-small-en-v1.5 float16 vectors), 25 collections. Rebuildable with scripts/build_sidecar.py on a GPU.

archives.name: crve_ppmi_over1m.tar.gz
archives.description: PPMI co-occurrence lists of the five collections over 1M documents, restricted to the anchors of the evaluated queries (for these anchors the lists equal a full computation). Hours to rebuild.

archives.name: crve_qe_llm_cache.tar.gz
archives.description: LLM-Q2E keyword generations (qwen3.5:4b through Ollama), 34,299 queries, replayed by scripts/run_qe_baselines.py. Not regenerable exactly.

archives.name: crve_qe_vocab.tar.gz
archives.description: BGE-QE vocabulary sidecars, 25 collections. A rebuild can pick other surface forms for a few terms.
